notCarried.description: The sheet 'Chart1' is not a worksheet (a chart sheet, or another that holds no cells), and is not opened.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a Formula the engine cannot read is refused by name: SUM({1,2,3})

refused.message: Sheet 'Trades', cell B7 (=SUM({1,2,3})): The engine cannot read the Formula: The Formula '=SUM({1,2,3})' cannot be read at position 5: '{' is not part of the formula syntax ExSheet reads.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a Formula the engine cannot read is refused by name: SUM((A1,A1))

refused.message: Sheet 'Trades', cell B7 (=SUM((A1,A1))): The engine cannot read the Formula: The Formula '=SUM((A1,A1))' cannot be read at position 8: ',' is not expected here.

cases.name: ADR-0330 §4: a Formula the engine cannot read is refused by name: A1:A2 A1:B1

refused.message: Sheet 'Trades', cell B7 (=A1:A2 A1:B1): The engine cannot read the Formula: The Formula '=A1:A2 A1:B1' cannot be read at position 7: the intersection operator (a space between two References) is not implemented.

refused.message: Sheet 'Trades', cell B7 (=_xlfn.SINGLE(A1:A3)*2): The Formula uses the implicit intersection operator (@), which the engine does not read.
